nodes.description: Interact with Chatwoot API to manage conversations, messages, contacts, and more

options.name: Get
options.description: Get account details, including settings such as auto-resolve and enabled features

options.name: Get Branded Email Layout
options.description: Get the Liquid HTML layout used for outgoing emails. Requires Chatwoot 4.17+ and an administrator token.

options.name: Update
options.description: Update account settings (name, locale, auto-resolve, company details)

options.name: Update Branded Email Layout
options.description: Set or remove the Liquid HTML layout used for outgoing emails. Requires Chatwoot 4.17+, an administrator token and the branded_email_templates feature flag (disabled by default).

options.name: Create
options.description: Invite a new agent (Chatwoot emails the invitation). Chatwoot 4.18 allows 100 agent creations per account per day by default (RATE_LIMIT_AGENT_CREATE); a full plan answers 402.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Remove an agent from the account. Chatwoot 4.18 allows 50 agent deletions per account per day by default (RATE_LIMIT_AGENT_DELETE).

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all agents in the account with their role and availability_status

options.name: Update
options.description: Update the name, role, availability or auto-offline setting of an agent

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new agent bot. Administrators get its access_token and secret in the output.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete an agent bot

options.name: Delete Avatar
options.description: Remove the avatar image of an agent bot

options.name: Get
options.description: Get an agent bot by ID

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all agent bots available to the account (including global system bots)

options.name: Reset Access Token
options.description: Generate a new API access token for an agent bot (the old one stops working) and return the bot with it. Administrator token required.
options.action: Reset an agent bot access token

options.name: Reset Secret
options.description: Generate a new secret for signing the webhook deliveries of an agent bot (X-Chatwoot-Signature) and return the bot with it. Administrator token required.

options.name: Update
options.description: Update an agent bot

options.name: Clone
options.description: Duplicate an automation rule (same name, event, conditions, actions, active flag and delay). Returns the new rule under "payload". A rule with an execution delay cannot be cloned while delayed automations are disabled (422).

options.name: Create
options.description: Create an automation rule. Every automation rule operation requires an administrator token.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete an automation rule

options.name: Get
options.description: Get an automation rule by ID. Returns the rule under "payload".

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all automation rules of the account. Returns them as a "payload" array.

options.name: Update
options.description: Update an automation rule. Only the fields you add are changed.

options.name: Add Agent
options.description: Add agents to a team

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new team

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a team

options.name: Delete Agent
options.description: Remove agents from a team

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a team by ID

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all teams in the account

options.name: Get Members
options.description: Get all members of a team

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a team

options.name: Update Agents
options.description: Replace all team members with new list

options.name: Add Agent
options.description: Add agents to an inbox and return the resulting member list

options.name: Create
options.description: Create an API, Email, LINE, SMS (Bandwidth), Telegram, Website or WhatsApp inbox

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete an inbox with its conversations (Chatwoot deletes it in the background)

options.name: Delete Agent
options.description: Remove agents from an inbox

options.name: Get
options.description: Get an inbox by ID (API inboxes include webhook_url, inbox_identifier and, for administrators, secret and hmac_token)

options.name: Get Agent Bot
options.description: Get the agent bot assigned to an inbox

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get the inboxes of the account, one item per inbox (administrators see every inbox, agents only the inboxes they are members of)

options.name: Get Members
options.description: Get the agents assigned to an inbox (one item per agent)

options.name: Get Message Templates
options.description: List the synced message templates of a WhatsApp inbox (Cloud API, 360dialog or Twilio WhatsApp). Requires Chatwoot 4.17+.

options.name: Reset Secret
options.description: Regenerate the secret that signs the webhook deliveries of an API inbox (X-Chatwoot-Signature) and return the inbox with the new secret. API inboxes only; administrator token required.

options.name: Rotate HMAC Token
options.description: Rotate the identity verification (HMAC) token of a Website or API inbox and return the inbox with the new hmac_token. Existing identifier hashes stop working. Requires Chatwoot 4.18+.

options.name: Set Agent Bot
options.description: Set or remove agent bot for an inbox

options.name: Sync Templates
options.description: Ask Chatwoot to re-download the message templates of a WhatsApp inbox from the provider (runs in the background)

options.name: Update
options.description: Update inbox settings and channel settings (e.g. the webhook URL of an API inbox)

options.name: Update Agents
options.description: Replace the agents of an inbox with the given list

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new label (requires an administrator token)

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a label (requires an administrator token)

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all labels in the account

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a label (requires an administrator token)

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a canned response (a saved reply agents insert with /short_code). The short code must be unique in the account.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a canned response

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get the canned responses of the account, optionally filtered by a search text

options.name: Update
options.description: Change the short code and/or content of a canned response

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new custom attribute definition (Chatwoot 4.14+ requires an administrator token; agent tokens get 401)

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a custom attribute definition (Chatwoot 4.14+ requires an administrator token; agent tokens get 401)

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a custom attribute by ID

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all custom attribute definitions of a model (contact, conversation or company)

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a custom attribute definition (Chatwoot 4.14+ requires an administrator token; agent tokens get 401)

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a saved filter (folder or segment) for the user who owns the API token

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a custom filter

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a custom filter by ID

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get the saved filters of one type that belong to the user who owns the API token

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a custom filter

options.name: Create
options.description: Create an account webhook. The output includes its secret: each delivery carries X-Chatwoot-Signature = "sha256=" + hex HMAC-SHA256 of "{X-Chatwoot-Timestamp}.{raw body}" keyed with that secret.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a webhook

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all webhooks in the account (one item per webhook, including its secret)

options.name: Update
options.description: Update the URL, events, name or inbox of a webhook

options.name: Add Labels
options.description: Add labels while keeping the existing conversation labels

options.name: Assign
options.description: Assign a conversation to an agent, agent bot, Captain assistant or team, or remove the assignee or team

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new conversation, optionally with an initial message

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a conversation

options.name: Delete Custom Attributes
options.description: Remove the given custom attribute keys from a conversation (Chatwoot 4.17+)

options.name: Filter
options.description: Filter conversations using advanced criteria

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a conversation by ID

options.name: Get Attachments
options.description: Get the files shared in a conversation, newest first

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get many conversations with optional filters

options.name: Get Meta
options.description: Get conversation counts (mine, assigned, unassigned, all) for the given filters

options.name: Get Unread Counts
options.description: Get unread conversation counts per inbox, label and team for the user that owns the API token. Requires Chatwoot 4.14.1+ and the internal conversation_unread_counts feature flag, which a super admin must enable for the account (otherwise 403).

options.name: List Labels
options.description: Get all labels for a conversation

options.name: Mark as Read
options.description: Mark a conversation as read by the user that owns the API token

options.name: Mark as Unread
options.description: Mark a conversation as unread (from its last incoming message)

options.name: Mute
options.description: Mute a conversation

options.name: Remove Labels
options.description: Remove the specified labels and keep the other conversation labels

options.name: Search
options.description: Search conversations by message content

options.name: Set Labels
options.description: Replace all conversation labels with the given list; an empty list clears them

options.name: Toggle Priority
options.description: Set conversation priority (urgent, high, medium, low) or clear it (none)

options.name: Toggle Typing
options.description: Show or hide the agent typing indicator in a conversation (not forwarded to WhatsApp by Evolution API inboxes)

options.name: Transcript
options.description: Send conversation transcript via email

options.name: Unmute
options.description: Unmute a conversation

options.name: Update
options.description: Update the priority or SLA policy of a conversation, or snooze it

options.name: Update Custom Attributes
options.description: Replace conversation custom attributes, or optionally merge with the existing ones on Chatwoot 4.17+

options.name: Update Status
options.description: Update status. Open assigns to an agent-role token owner; on Chatwoot 4.17.1 and later any user token also removes the bot or Captain assignee.

options.name: Create
options.description: Send a message to a conversation, optionally with file attachments from binary data

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a message from a conversation (its content is replaced and attachments are removed)

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get messages from a conversation, oldest first

options.name: Retry
options.description: Send a failed outgoing message again through its channel (WhatsApp Cloud, SMS, email, Telegram...). API inboxes (e.g. Evolution) are not re-delivered: Chatwoot only resets the status to Sent.

options.name: Update Delivery Status
options.description: Set the delivery status (sent, delivered, read, failed) of a message in an API inbox. Message content cannot be edited.

options.name: Add Labels
options.description: Add labels to a contact, keeping the labels it already has

options.name: Contactable Inboxes
options.description: Get inboxes that can be used to reach a contact

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new contact, optionally linked to an inbox

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a contact (requires an administrator token)

options.name: Delete Custom Attributes
options.description: Remove custom attribute keys from a contact, keeping the others

options.name: Export
options.description: Start a CSV export of contacts; Chatwoot emails the download link to the token owner (requires an administrator token)

options.name: Filter
options.description: Filter contacts by conditions on their attributes, labels and custom attributes

options.name: Find by WhatsApp Number
options.description: Find the contact of a WhatsApp number or JID, trying the +52/+521, +54/+549 and Brazil 9-digit variants and @s.whatsapp.net/@lid identifiers

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a contact by ID

options.name: Get Attachments
options.description: Get the files shared in a contact's conversations (requires Chatwoot 4.14+)

options.name: Get Conversations
options.description: Get the recent conversations of a contact (at most 20, or 25 on Chatwoot 4.18+), most recently active first

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get many contacts, optionally filtered by labels

options.name: Import
options.description: Import contacts from a CSV file in a binary property (requires an administrator token)

options.name: Link to Inbox
options.description: Link an existing contact to an inbox (create a contact inbox with a source ID)

options.name: List Labels
options.description: Get all labels for a contact

options.name: Merge
options.description: Merge two contacts into one

options.name: Remove Labels
options.description: Remove labels from a contact, keeping its other labels

options.name: Search
options.description: Search contacts by name, email, phone, or identifier

options.name: Set Labels
options.description: Replace all contact labels with the given list; an empty list clears them

options.name: Set Labels (Alias)
options.description: Replace all labels of a contact with the given list

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a contact

options.name: Account Summary
options.description: Get summary metrics (conversations, messages, avg first response/resolution/reply time, resolutions) for the account or one agent/inbox/label/team, with the previous period for comparison

options.name: Agent Statistics
options.description: Download per-agent metrics as CSV (file or parsed rows). For JSON use Summary Report → Agent Summary.

options.name: Bot Metrics
options.description: Get bot conversation/message counts and resolution/handoff rates. Since Chatwoot 4.14 a bot resolution is not counted when the conversation was also handed off.

options.name: Bot Summary
options.description: Get bot resolutions and handoffs counts with the previous period. Since Chatwoot 4.14 bot resolutions exclude conversations that were handed off to an agent.

options.name: Conversation Counts
options.description: Count open conversations visible to the token user by assignee: mine, assigned, unassigned and all. Chatwoot 4.18 defaults to 30 requests per minute per user. Use Conversation → Get Meta to filter other statuses.

options.name: Conversation Reporting Events
options.description: Get the raw reporting events of one conversation (first response, reply times, resolutions, bot handoffs). Enterprise.

options.name: Conversation Statistics
options.description: Get live open/unattended conversation counts for the account, or per agent (all agents, paginated automatically)

options.name: Conversation Traffic
options.description: Download the hourly conversation heatmap of the last N days as CSV (file or parsed rows)

options.name: Conversations Summary
options.description: Download the account conversation summary as CSV (file or parsed rows)

options.name: Drilldown
options.description: List the conversations or messages behind one timeseries bucket of a metric (e.g. which conversations had a slow first response on a given day). Administrators only. Chatwoot allows 10 drilldown requests per minute per user by default (100 records per request). Requires Chatwoot 4.16+.

options.name: First Response Time Distribution
options.description: Get first response counts per channel type in buckets (0-1h, 1-4h, 4-8h, 8-24h, 24h+)

options.name: Inbox Label Matrix
options.description: Get a matrix of conversation counts per inbox and label

options.name: Inbox Statistics
options.description: Download per-inbox metrics as CSV (file or parsed rows). For JSON use Summary Report → Inbox Summary.

options.name: Label Statistics
options.description: Download per-label metrics as CSV (file or parsed rows). For JSON use Summary Report → Label Summary.

options.name: Outgoing Messages Count
options.description: Get outgoing message counts grouped by agent, team, inbox or label

options.name: Reporting Events
options.description: List raw reporting events (first_response, reply_time, conversation_resolved, bot handoffs...) with their durations, for BI exports. Enterprise, administrators only.

options.name: Team Statistics
options.description: Download per-team metrics as CSV (file or parsed rows). For JSON use Summary Report → Team Summary.

options.name: Timeseries
options.description: Get a metric grouped by hour/day/week/month/year for the account or one entity

options.name: Year in Review
options.description: Get personal annual statistics for the API token user and conversations assigned to that user. Chatwoot saves the first result for each account/year in the user settings and reuses it without refreshing. User tokens only; agent bot tokens are unsupported.

options.name: Fetch
options.description: Get the profile of the user that owns the access token (name, email, role and availability per account)

options.name: Set Availability
options.description: Set the availability (online, busy or offline) of the token owner in the account of the credential

options.name: Update
options.description: Update the profile of the user that owns the access token (name, display name, email, signature, availability)

options.name: Bulk Delete Articles
options.description: Delete several articles of a portal at once. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Bulk Update Article Category
options.description: Move several articles to another category. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Bulk Update Article Status
options.description: Publish, archive or move to draft several articles at once. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Create Article
options.description: Create a help center article (draft by default). The author defaults to the token owner.

options.name: Create Category
options.description: Create a new help center category

options.name: Create Portal
options.description: Create a new help center portal (locales, layout, color, social links)

options.name: Delete Article
options.description: Delete a help center article

options.name: Delete Category
options.description: Delete a help center category

options.name: Delete Portal
options.description: Delete a help center portal with its categories and articles

options.name: Get Article
options.description: Get a help center article with its content, draft edits and category

options.name: Get Category
options.description: Get a help center category

options.name: Get Portal
options.description: Get a help center portal with its config and article counts

options.name: List Articles
options.description: List or search the articles of a portal (filter by locale, category, status, author)

options.name: List Categories
options.description: List the categories of a portal

options.name: List Portals
options.description: List all help center portals

options.name: Update Article
options.description: Update an article, or stage a draft edit of a published article (Draft Title/Content, Chatwoot 4.16+)

options.name: Update Category
options.description: Update a help center category

options.name: Update Portal
options.description: Update a help center portal (config changes are merged into the current config)

options.name: Create Hook
options.description: Connect an integration app (e.g. Dialogflow, OpenAI, Cloudflare RealtimeKit video calls) with its settings

options.name: Delete Hook
options.description: Delete an integration hook

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get the integration apps available to the account, each with its hooks (hook IDs are needed to update or delete them)

options.name: Update Hook
options.description: Update the settings or enable/disable an integration hook

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get audit log entries (who changed agents, inboxes, teams, webhooks, automations, macros, sign-ins, deleted conversations/messages). Enterprise, administrators only; an empty list can mean the audit_logs feature is disabled. Since 4.18 IPs are masked and a location is added.

options.name: Download
options.description: Download CSAT responses as CSV (file or parsed rows) with agent, rating, feedback, contact and conversation link. Since and Until are required.

options.name: Get by Conversation
options.description: Get the CSAT survey response of one conversation (no output item when the contact did not answer)

options.name: Get Many
options.description: List CSAT survey responses (rating, feedback, contact, assigned agent, conversation_id) filtered by date range, agents, inbox, team or rating

options.name: Metrics
options.description: Get CSAT totals: number of responses, count per rating and number of surveys sent

options.name: Update Review Notes
options.description: Set the internal review notes of a CSAT response. Enterprise; administrators or report managers.

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a macro (a saved list of actions agents can run on a conversation). Returns it under "payload".

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a macro. Global macros can only be deleted by administrators, personal macros only by their author (Chatwoot 4.13 also let the author delete a global macro).

options.name: Execute
options.description: Queue a macro to run on one or more conversations. Chatwoot runs it asynchronously and always answers 200, so success means "queued"; since 4.18 conversations the token user cannot access are skipped silently (use an administrator token).

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a macro by ID (global macros, or personal macros of the token user). Returns it under "payload".

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get the macros visible to the token user: all global macros plus their own personal macros, as a "payload" array

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a macro. Global macros can only be edited by administrators, personal macros only by their author (Chatwoot 4.13 also let the author edit a global macro).

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a notification of the token user

options.name: Delete All
options.description: Delete all notifications of the token user in this account, or only the read ones. Chatwoot deletes them in a background job.

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get the notifications of the token user (the user who owns the API access token), newest activity first. Read and snoozed notifications are excluded unless included in Options.

options.name: Get Settings
options.description: Get the email and push notification preferences of the token user in this account

options.name: Mark All Read
options.description: Mark all notifications of the token user in this account as read

options.name: Mark Read
options.description: Mark a notification as read

options.name: Mark Unread
options.description: Mark a notification as unread

options.name: Snooze
options.description: Hide a notification until a given date and time

options.name: Unread Count
options.description: Get the number of unread, non-snoozed notifications of the token user, as { unread_count }

options.name: Update Settings
options.description: Choose which events send email and push notifications to the token user. A list you leave out keeps its current value.

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a campaign (administrator token). Website: set Trigger URL. SMS: set Audience Label IDs. WhatsApp: set Audience Label IDs and Template Params.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a campaign

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a campaign by ID. campaign_status is active, processing or completed; one-off SMS/WhatsApp campaigns also return scheduled_at as Unix seconds.

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all campaigns of the account (administrator token), one item per campaign. The "id" of each item is the ID the other campaign operations take.

options.name: Get Metrics
options.description: Get delivery totals of a one-off WhatsApp campaign (audience, sent, delivered, read, failed, skipped). Requires Chatwoot 4.17+ Enterprise with WhatsApp campaigns enabled.

options.name: Get Recipients
options.description: Get the recipients of a one-off WhatsApp campaign with their delivery status and error details. Requires Chatwoot 4.17+ Enterprise with WhatsApp campaigns enabled.

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a campaign. Completed one-off campaigns cannot be changed.

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a note on a contact

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a contact note

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all notes for a contact

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a contact note

options.name: Add
options.description: Add agents as participants of a conversation

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all participants of a conversation

options.name: Remove
options.description: Remove participants from a conversation

options.name: Replace
options.description: Set the exact list of participants of a conversation (adds the missing ones, removes the rest)

options.name: Add Contact
options.description: Link a contact to the company (a contact belongs to one company; it is moved if already linked elsewhere). Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.
options.action: Add a contact to a company

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new company (Enterprise, companies feature)

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a company (Enterprise). Since Chatwoot 4.14 the deletion runs in the background.

options.name: Delete Avatar
options.description: Remove the company's avatar image. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Delete Custom Attributes
options.description: Remove custom attributes from a company by key. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a company by ID (Enterprise, companies feature)

options.name: Get Contacts
options.description: List the contacts linked to a company. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Get Conversations
options.description: Get the 20 most recent conversations of the company's contacts (only those the user can access). Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all companies (Enterprise, companies feature)

options.name: Get Notes
options.description: Get the 20 most recent notes written on the company's contacts. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.

options.name: Remove Contact
options.description: Unlink a contact from the company. Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.
options.action: Remove a contact from a company

options.name: Search
options.description: Search companies by name or domain (Enterprise, companies feature)

options.name: Search Contacts
options.description: Search contacts that are NOT linked to the company yet (candidates for Add Contact). Requires Chatwoot 4.14+.
options.action: Search contacts to add to a company

options.name: Update
options.description: Update a company (Enterprise, companies feature)

options.name: Search All
options.description: Search conversations, contacts, messages and articles at once (first page of each, grouped in one item)

options.name: Search Articles
options.description: Search Help Center articles

options.name: Search Contacts
options.description: Search contacts

options.name: Search Conversations
options.description: Search conversations by ID or contact details

options.name: Search Messages
options.description: Search message content

options.name: Create
options.description: Create an SLA policy (thresholds in seconds). Enterprise SLA feature, administrators only.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete an SLA policy (deleted in the background). Enterprise SLA feature, administrators only.

options.name: Get
options.description: Get an SLA policy by ID. Enterprise SLA feature.

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get all SLA policies (one item per policy). Enterprise SLA feature.

options.name: Update
options.description: Update an SLA policy. Enterprise SLA feature, administrators only.

options.name: Download
options.description: Download the breached conversations as CSV (file or parsed rows). Enterprise SLA feature, administrators only.

options.name: Get Many
options.description: List SLA breaches (missed or active with misses): policy, due dates, conversation, labels, assignee and SLA events. Enterprise SLA feature, administrators only.

options.name: Metrics
options.description: Get total applied SLAs, number of misses and hit rate. Enterprise SLA feature, administrators only.

options.name: Conversation Metrics
options.description: Get real-time conversation counts (open, unattended, unassigned, pending)

options.name: Grouped Conversation Metrics
options.description: Get real-time conversation counts grouped by team or agent

options.name: Agent Summary
options.description: Get per-agent summary metrics (JSON)

options.name: Channel Summary
options.description: Get per-channel summary metrics (max 6-month range)

options.name: Inbox Summary
options.description: Get per-inbox summary metrics (JSON)

options.name: Label Summary
options.description: Get per-label summary metrics (JSON)

options.name: Team Summary
options.description: Get per-team summary metrics (JSON)

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new account (tenant), optionally with status, features, limits and custom attributes

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete an account created by this Platform App. Chatwoot deletes it and all its data in a background job.

options.name: Get
options.description: Get an account created by this Platform App, with its enabled features, limits and status

options.name: Get Many
options.description: List the accounts created by this Platform App

options.name: Update
options.description: Update an account: name, locale, domain, support email, status (active or suspended), features, limits or custom attributes

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a user (confirmed, no confirmation email). Add it to an account with Account User > Create.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a user created by this Platform App (processed in a background job)

options.name: Get
options.description: Get a user created by this Platform App, including its access token and account memberships

options.name: Get Access Token
options.description: Get the user's Application API access token, to call the Application API on behalf of this user

options.name: Get SSO URL
options.description: Get a one-time login URL for the Chatwoot dashboard (valid for 5 minutes)

options.name: Update
options.description: Update the name, display name, email, password or custom attributes of a user

options.name: Create
options.description: Add a user to an account with a role. If the user is already a member, only the role is changed.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Remove a user from an account (the user itself is kept). Chatwoot also answers success when the user was not a member.

options.name: Get Many
options.description: List the memberships of an account: user_id, role, availability and timestamps

options.name: Create
options.description: Create an agent bot through the Platform API, either for one account or as a global bot. The response includes the bot access token.

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete an agent bot created by this Platform App

options.name: Delete Avatar
options.description: Remove the avatar image of an agent bot created by this Platform App

options.name: Get
options.description: Get an agent bot created by this Platform App, including its access token

options.name: Get Many
options.description: List the agent bots created by this Platform App, optionally only those of one account

options.name: Update
options.description: Update the name, description, webhook URL, avatar or account of an agent bot created by this Platform App

options.name: Create
options.description: Create (or reuse) a contact in the API inbox of the credential and return its source_id, the Contact Identifier used by the other Public API operations

properties.name: conditions
properties.description: Non-empty JSON array of conditions; at least one is required because an empty list runs on every event. Each item: {"attribute_key", "filter_operator", "values": [...], "query_operator"}. query_operator ("and"/"or") joins a condition with the next one: set it on every condition except the last, which uses null. Standard attribute_key values: status, inbox_id, assignee_id, team_id, priority, labels, content, message_type, private_note, email, phone_number, company_name, country_code, city, browser_language, conversation_language, mail_subject, referer (Enterprise adds sla_policy_id). Custom attributes use their key plus "custom_attribute_type": "contact_attribute" or "conversation_attribute". Operators: equal_to, not_equal_to, contains, does_not_contain, starts_with, is_present, is_not_present, is_greater_than, is_less_than, attribute_changed. Chatwoot 4.14+ renamed "company" to "company_name"; the node rewrites a standard "company" key automatically (so Chatwoot 4.13 and older cannot use this condition). Example: [{"attribute_key":"status","filter_operator":"equal_to","values":["open"],"query_operator":null}]

properties.name: actions
properties.description: JSON array of actions. Each item: {"action_name", "action_params": [...]}. Valid action_name values: assign_agent, assign_team, remove_assigned_agent, remove_assigned_team, add_label, remove_label, send_message, add_private_note, send_email_to_team, send_email_transcript, send_webhook_event, mute_conversation, snooze_conversation, resolve_conversation, open_conversation, pending_conversation, change_status, change_priority, send_attachment (Enterprise adds add_sla). Example: [{"action_name":"assign_team","action_params":[1]},{"action_name":"add_label","action_params":["vip"]}]

If Chatwoot reaches this n8n URL through a private address (Docker service name, localhost, 10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x), set SAFE_FETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK=true on the Chatwoot server (available since 4.14.1), otherwise every delivery is dropped silently (Chatwoot only logs "Invalid webhook URL").

options.name: Account Webhook (Automatic)
options.description: n8n creates a Chatwoot account webhook for this URL when the workflow is activated, stores its signing secret and deletes it on deactivation. Needs an administrator API access token (on Chatwoot Cloud, a plan with API and webhooks). Do not paste this URL into an agent bot or API channel: they sign with their own secret and are rejected with HTTP 401 (use the Manual URL source). API channel message deliveries rejected with an error are marked as failed in Chatwoot.

options.name: Agent Bot / API Channel (Manual URL)
options.description: You paste this URL into an agent bot, an API channel inbox or a webhook you manage in Chatwoot, and provide its signing secret. n8n registers nothing in Chatwoot. Use the Production URL after testing: API channel message deliveries receiving an error (invalid signature, inactive workflow or Test URL not listening) are marked as failed in Chatwoot.

properties.displayName: Paste this node's Production URL (or the Test URL while testing) into Chatwoot: the agent bot's Webhook URL (Settings > Bots), the API channel inbox's Webhook URL (Settings > Inboxes > the inbox > Settings) or a webhook in Settings > Integrations > Webhooks. Then copy its Webhook Secret into Signing Secret. Agent bots: when n8n answers with an error (workflow inactive, invalid signature), Chatwoot moves pending conversations to Open unless the account keeps them pending on bot failure. API channels: an error response marks the message as failed, including when the Test URL is not listening. Use the Production URL after testing.

options.name: includeRawBody

options.name: redactChannelSecrets
options.description: Whether to replace secrets inside the `channel` object of inbox_created / inbox_updated (API channel secret and HMAC token, e-mail passwords, bot and access tokens, provider API keys) with "[REDACTED]" before n8n stores the execution

options.description: Maximum age of X-Chatwoot-Timestamp, in seconds. Rejects stale signatures; deliveries inside this window are not deduplicated. 0 disables the timestamp check (the signature is still verified).

options.name: verifySignature
